answer.rationale: p99 write-path penalty rising on the same release window (release +2h, climb +90m), settlement peak already saturating the write path. Rollback is the only intervention validated here that attenuates regression exactly while preserving customer writes during a heavy-write peak (b1: clean rollback, prior build stable, zero customer impact). Routing reads (b5), capacity adds (b3), or failover (b2) do not address a code-driven p99 climb and would either be inert or risky at peak. Circuit breakers (b4) target a specific payment-dependency outage path, which is not yet indicated. Verifying b1 confirms rollback safety/no-customer-loss record; verifying b6 confirms whether the canary cohort gating mechanism missed this flavor of regression or whether rollback expecting the prior build’s restored stability is the sound bet.
